name: Coordinator notes on the web service
summary: Existing .447 HTTP notes on one installation: live coordinators of program-linked projects send bounded plain-text notes, read their inbox/outbox, reply in a thread or mark noted. Only coordinators of the two projects may read note text. Notes are stored by the web service; unsettled notes fold into granted agents' wait fingerprints. This describes the existing HTTP feature, not the proposed SSH host adapter in the .458 design.
